diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle (period 3 MIN) containing three actions. The candidate was a one-shot script (period 0) with a trailing delay, missing the repetition mechanism required by the IR's cycle node.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period from 0 to 180000 to enable the repeating cycle. Removed the trailing delay(3 MIN) and restructured the script to execute the body actions at the start of every period, then delay at the end of the body before the next iteration begins.
